name: Shammah (David's brother)
title: Jesse's third son
summary: Shammah was the third son of Jesse from Bethlehem and one of King David's older brothers. He was among the sons that the prophet Samuel inspected when he came to anoint a new king over Israel, but God chose the youngest brother, David, instead.

keyEvents.title: Passed Over by Samuel
keyEvents.description: When the prophet Samuel came to Bethlehem to anoint a new king, Jesse let Shammah pass before Samuel along with his other sons, but the Lord had not chosen him.

keyEvents.title: At the Front Against the Philistines
keyEvents.description: Shammah and his two older brothers served in Saul's army during the war against the Philistines in the Valley of Elah, when Goliath challenged Israel.

keyEvents.title: Received Supplies from David
keyEvents.description: Jesse sent young David with food and supplies to Shammah and his brothers at the front, which led to David's encounter with Goliath.
